addIf.confirmation: First real test since being set: a confirmed 1H close printed at 84,953.5 (~05:00 COT), briefly above this level, but the very next confirmed 1H candle closed back inside the range at 84,875.4 -- a fakeout, not a sustained break. decisionBox.changed: Levels unchanged, but addIf (84,944.4) was tested for the first time since being set and failed to hold -- a fakeout, not a break. What DID change operationally: added a small 20 USDT tranche back onto the spot core from idle cash, citing the 4H MACD histogram flipping positive since midnight (-41.05 -> +7.13), 1H momentum still building (+32.47 -> +57.57), and fresh OKX liquidations running almost entirely short-side (~$207k vs ~$2k long) clustered 84,850-85,100 right at/above spot -- consistent with shorts getting squeezed on the push to the new local high. Kept the add small and spot-only (no leverage) since the breakout itself failed; most of cash stays in reserve ahead of the Oct-1 30 USDT charge.
